reports.title: Vela Array calibration 1.9 leaves beta
reports.summary: Calibration set 1.9 graduated from beta after three nights of commissioning.

reports.title: Vela Array releases calibration set 2.4
reports.summary: Calibration set 2.4 is available for the north camera. The release updates the dark frames used in low-light reduction.

reports.title: Vela Array releases calibration set 2.4
reports.summary: Observatory Wire republishes the north camera calibration notice. Its availability report is attributed to Indigo Instruments.

reports.title: Autumn sky atlas reading room opens
reports.summary: The library will open its sky atlas collection for two evenings in September.

reports.title: Vela Array will not release calibration set 2.4
reports.summary: Calibration set 2.4 is on hold after an offset in the dark frames. The operations desk asks observers to keep using set 2.3 until it issues a replacement.

reports.title: Mesa bench repeats the low-light offset test
reports.summary: The calibration team repeated the offset test on one north camera sensor. The southern instruments were outside the trial.
